map.L1 L2 正则化惩罚 使用指南: L1 L2 Regularization Penalty User Guide
map.L1/L2 正则化惩罚计算器，输入权重与正则系数求对损失函数的惩罚项，对比 La: L1/L2 regularization penalty calculator: enter weights and regularization coefficients to get the penalty added to the loss function, comparing Lasso and Ridge regularization.
map.L1 = λ₁·Σ|wᵢ|；L2 = λ₂·Σwᵢ²；总惩罚 = L1 + L2: L1 = λ1·Σ|wi|; L2 = λ2·Σwi²; total penalty = L1 + L2
map.L1 在 0 处不可导且梯度恒为 ±λ，会把不重要权重精确压到 0，产生稀疏解可: L1 is non-differentiable at 0 and its gradient is always ±λ, so it pushes unimportant weights exactly to 0, giving a sparse solution usable for feature selection; the L2 penalty is proportional to the weight, so its push weakens near 0, only shrinking uniformly and keeping small weights, usually generalizing more stably. Using both together is Elastic Net.
map.惩罚项加入损失：L_total=Loss+λ₁‖w‖₁+λ₂‖w‖₂²，统称弹性: Penalty added to the loss: L_total = Loss + λ1‖w‖₁ + λ2‖w‖₂², collectively called Elastic Net.
map.L1 促稀疏(特征选择)，L2 促平滑(权重衰减)，二者互补。: L1 promotes sparsity (feature selection), L2 promotes smoothness (weight decay); the two complement each other.
map.权重衰减(weight decay)本质是 L2，深度学习常用之稳定训练。: Weight decay is essentially L2, commonly used in deep learning to stabilize training.
map.Elastic Net 比单独 L1/L2 好在哪？: Where is Elastic Net better than L1 or L2 alone?
map.同时获得稀疏性与分组稳定性，尤其特征高度相关时比纯 L1 更稳健；代价是多一个超: It gains both sparsity and grouping stability, more robust than pure L1 especially when features are highly correlated; the cost is one more hyperparameter to tune by cross-validation.
map.权重衰减和 L2 完全等价吗？: Is weight decay exactly equivalent to L2?
map.在标准 SGD 下等价；但用 AdamW 时权重衰减与梯度解耦，实现不同、效果更: Equivalent under standard SGD; but with AdamW weight decay is decoupled from the gradient, so the implementation differs and works better, and it cannot simply be substituted as L2.
